speaker: Mr Alex Yam
text: asked	the Minister for National Development (a) what have been the success rates for first-timer and second-timer HDB BTO applicants from 2013-2015; (b) whether the current building rate for new flats is sustainable in light of the application rates; and (c) what are some of the main reasons for multiple unsuccessful applications.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: This helped to clear the demand backlog for first-timers.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: And that is comparable to the rate in 2014.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: This means that most of the families would have been able to book a flat on their first attempt.
